title: Samsung, Dexcom, and recent Android patch
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/2915
There are reports of some Samsung phones having difficulty after a recent (June 2023) Samsung patch. This affects Bluetooth operation. So, if you use xDrip only as a follower (BYODA, Companion app mode, CareLink, Nightscout follower, xDrip sync follower, ...), this will not be an issue. Originally posted by **Navid200** June 28, 2023 Please keep your comments as short as possible.

comments.body:
1- Make sure all settings are correct: https://navid200.github.io/xDrip/docs/G6-Recommended-Settings.html

2- Please make sure you are using the latest xDrip Nightly.  https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2023.07.01
  
3- Please enable OB1 debugging: https://navid200.github.io/xDrip/docs/Dexcom/OB1Debug.html  
3b- Restart the phone.  
  
4- If it is not paired, do what you usually do to pair.  Wait for it to work and fail.  If it does not fail and the problem is resolved, perfect.  Please tell us.  If the problem persists, please continue.  
  
5- Look at the logs. You should see a lot more logs than usual.  
Only if you have waited for a while so that xDrip has operated with detail logs enabled, tap on "Upload logs" at the bottom.  
Add some relative narrative, like "gaps of x minutes between readings or whatever the problem is", and submit.  
  
6- Post in this thread and state you just uploaded including an identifying component in your upload so that the developer can communicate with you knowing who uploaded the logs.  
  
7- Please don't post here just because you have a problem.  Please allow this thread to be dedicated to the specific topic of the latest Samsung update impact.   If you have any other problems, please post here: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions

I would like to provide the information, that it seems the Dexcom App has also issues with the latest Samsung update, [see](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dexcom.g6.region3.mgdl&gl=DE).

On my smartphone Samsung A53 with Andoid V13, I get very random blood sugar values with Xdrip. The settings seem to be correct. I'm updating Xdrip as soon something is available with hoping we get a workaround 🙏🏼

It may be of use to inform you that CamAPS have sent out this communication to it’s users that Samsung will issue an update on 24th July to fix to the recent signal loss issues on A series devices.  I suspect this issue is common to what is being seen for xdrip users…

![IMG_2119](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/assets/55636308/82520175-8239-4700-a0d9-db7d9954a41d)

Right now I'm not using xDrip for mine G5 sensors but I realized that after the latest Samsung patch, my S20+ was having more issues connecting to my pump with AndroidAPS, something that I didn't have before. Then I realized that Bluetooth was set to battery optimization after the update, after I changed the setting, the connection was improved. You can try and check if improves the connection.
